full_page.content:
Page 116 Cont.
Dec. 14 Joanne Du Rivage - 19 - of Cleveland; spinal maningitis - 22 weeks and was almost blind for time. Mother also followed same experience Both are here Today. Mother entirely recovered; but daughter - to be married on St. Valentine day ..... enrolled and prayd for Oct. 18th Enrolled now $1.
James Stach - 16 - has difficulty in chewing four years ago - was knocked by car and 8 days unconscious - a year later a pistol exploded the bullet lodging in his head still-there - Enrolled To-day.
Dec. 17 Ronald McDonald - 9 - fearful case of diabetis; when normal and himself child-loving, obliging, best willed, but like a drunken man ... when attacks come on.
Mary Ann Malszecki - 2 - asthma and Hay fever ...
Page 117
Dec. 17 John Mccarthy - 42 - of Belville, Mich. - serious stomach.
27 Constantine Barski - 63 - man of family, lung-cancer very threatenint Drs. give very little hope. Made offering To-nite 5. for PP. SSoul Joseph Liedel - 43 - stomach tumor had 25 hemorages last ten days. Mrs. Grace Smith - 44 - nerveous break - married presbiter. Ralph Clough - 50 - in observation at Ford's .... Richard Wolf - 19 - in battle of Tarawa in S. Pacific.
Page 118
1944, January
Jan 2 Mrs. Caroline Cross - 71 - 4 Hamilton Ont. - breast removed. ... Baby Cathie Lynn - 19 mo. methodist - enlarged head - bright ... can't walk ...
5th Louise Woelkers - 3 - a tapeworm since last March, thought to have started from eating beef not thoroughly cooked .... Enrolled. Report next day "at 9;30 a great relief came last night. Had been enrolled Jan. 2nd 1.
3rd Mrs. Marie Stanse1 - 52 - of Toledo - adisons disease and diabetis. - Dr's give very little
Vincent Howe - about 60 - malignent tumor of brain.
